Hymn 320: The Priesthood of Our Lord
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Robert P. Manookin
Lyricist/Text Author: Gordon B. Hinckley
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 320 titled "The Priesthood of Our Lord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Robert P. Manookin and the lyrics were written by Gordon B. Hinckley.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
